cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: Export CSV not working on local development instance
cases.description: # Bug report - [x] I confirm this is a bug with Supabase, not with my own application. - [x] I confirm I have searched the [Docs](https://docs.supabase.com), GitHub [Discussions](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/discussions), and [Discord](https://discord.supabase.com). ## Describe the bug On the Studio URL: http://127.0.0.1:54323, in a table, I tried to export table data by clicking on `Export as CSV` but nothing happened. ## To Reproduce 1. Run a local development Supabase instance and go to the Studio URL: http://127.0.0.1:54323 2. Make sure you have a table with some rows and data in them 3. In the left side menu, click on the arrow next to the table name and click `Export as CSV` 4. See? Nothing happens, no download, no error displayed. ## Expected behavior A CSV file should be downloaded. I tried on the hosted Supabase instance and it works as expected. ## System information - OS: macOS 13.2.1 Ventura - Browser (if applies) Arc and Firefox

evidence.eventual_fix_title: fix: Unable to export data from the table to CSV
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement: fix: Unable to export data from the table to CSV ## What kind of change does this PR introduce? fixes: https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues/19275 ## What is the current behavior? Unable export table to CSV not working on local development ## What is the new behavior? Can export table to CSV not working on local development ## Additional context Because on local development we can send empty connection string to query data, so in this PR we just make it like option on `PLATFORM`
